title: aster sedifolius subsp. acer
intro: Aster sedifolius subsp. acer, commonly known as Mountain Aster, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Aster are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation, with its bioactive constituents including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Aster sedifolius subsp. acer for medicinal use.
